description: This file contains unit tests and mock implementations for cookie store components in the Chromium project, specifically testing the CookieMonster's persistent cookie store functionality.

classes.name: CookieStoreCommand
classes.description: Represents commands for cookie store operations, such as load, add, remove, with associated data.

classes.name: MockPersistentCookieStore
classes.description: A mock implementation of a persistent cookie store for testing purposes.

classes.name: MockSimplePersistentCookieStore
classes.description: A simplified mock cookie store that manages cookies in-memory for testing.

methods.name: CookieStoreCommand::CookieStoreCommand
methods.description: Constructor initializing a command with type, callback, and key.

methods.name: CookieStoreCommand::CookieStoreCommand
methods.description: Constructor initializing a command with type and a cookie.

methods.name: MockPersistentCookieStore::SetLoadExpectation
methods.description: Sets expected return value and result for load operations.

methods.name: MockPersistentCookieStore::Load
methods.description: Loads cookies asynchronously, invoking callback with results.

methods.name: MockPersistentCookieStore::LoadCookiesForKey
methods.description: Loads cookies for a specific key asynchronously.

methods.name: MockPersistentCookieStore::AddCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the store.

methods.name: MockPersistentCookieStore::UpdateCookieAccessTime
methods.description: Updates the last access time of a cookie.

methods.description: Deletes a cookie from the store.

methods.description: Loads cookies for a specific key.

methods.name: MockSimplePersistentCookieStore::AddCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the in-memory store.

methods.description: Updates last access time for a cookie.

methods.name: MockSimplePersistentCookieStore::DeleteCookie
methods.description: Removes a cookie from the store.
